'''Domir''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by ten [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', a [[:File:Domir.jpg|brightly lit star]] could be seen in the Dathomir system. This may have been a possible depiction of Domir.
